title: MindState
description: First-class temporal mental-state record under optional capability spoke-cognition. Strictly derivative of the holder KnowledgeEntry's modules.mental / modules.cognition (settled home); never a second authority. Distinct from KnowledgeEntry ontology labels such as entry_type: "character" or profile "mind". Engines (belief revision, ToM inference) are product-owned; SPOKE owns the wire shape.

holder_entry_id.description: Reference to the mental actor's KnowledgeEntry (entry_id). This record is a temporal derivative of that entry's modules.mental / modules.cognition (settled home); never a second authority.

occurred_at.description: When the mental state held (RFC 3339 UTC datetime).

sort_key.description: Opaque ordering hint within a mental-state timeline (products define grammar).

snapshot.description: Derivative full-field snapshot of the holder's mental state at this point in time.

deltas.description: Derivative field-level change records since the prior mental state (temporal-delta presentation only).

cognition.description: Optional derivative projection of the selected holder-side cognition authority with all retained matching assessments and trace; never a second authority.
